signal_watch.author: Vercel AI
signal_watch.summary: Vercel Flags can now block a deployment from reaching production if you’ve declared a flag in code but haven’t created it in your project. Without that definition, your app can silently fall back to the flag’s default value, even if that turns on a feature you meant to keep off. The Flag Definitions Present Deployment Check runs when a deployment is ready.
